item.title: Ingeborg Doblander: shaping sound in global productions and the Wiener Konzerthaus
item.description: With over three decades in live sound and technical production, Ingeborg Doblander has shaped acoustic experiences on stages ranging from Linz’s “Klangwolke” and Munich’s “Jazz Tage” to international productions with artists such as Ten Pen Chii and Sir Peter Hall in the 1990s. item.title: The legal strain on Europe’s asylum system
item.description: In July, Greece temporarily suspended processing asylum requests. item.title: JFK’s grandson joins competitive congressional field
item.description: Jerry Nadler has represented New York’s 12th District, which encompasses Midtown Manhattan, the Upper East Side and Upper West Side for 17 terms.
